mapper.select: SELECT ksva.id, ksva.`type` 'vacateType', ksva.begin_time, ksva.end_time, ksva.`status`, su.nick_name `approveName`, su.avatar `approveByHead`, ksva.approve_time, ksva.approve_opinion, ksva.student_id, ksva.`reason` 'vacateReason' FROM kg_student_vacate_apply ksva LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON ksva.approve_by = su.user_id WHERE ksva.del_flag = FALSE AND ksva.id = #{vacateApplyId}
